objective: Valid static entrapment is desirable when constraints dominate; invalid initial material/body overlap is a separate geometry/ownership observation, not a spontaneous-escape objective.
warmup: One zero-gravity neutral dynamic Rapier initialization step before native construction; restore exact authored gravity and verify unchanged pose/zero motion.
collisions: Actual authored layer/mask 1 plus native hard-terrain colliders, except separately labelled collision-disabled isolation.
hypothesis: A passive wrench dissipative at sampling can add kinetic energy after a permitted live velocity reversal. Revalidate only passive work at application; preserve event, legacy, correction, budgets and all ownership/refusal fences.

variant.mechanism: largest s in [0,1] satisfying b*s+a*s*s <= 0 after correction clipping and nonpassive impulse, using live mass/inertia/COM and existing age scaling
variant.rollback: Reject general promotion if gravity support/stability worsens, material accounting changes, event/legacy impulse changes or ownership/readback gates fail. Retain negative outcomes without tuning.

static_observation.qualification: Prospective descriptive stability screen, separate from geometry validity and original SOL thresholds; no spontaneous clearance requirement.

external_drive: Direct force/impulse uses bridge.pack_sample with truthful drive flags. Powered controls use authored controller observations. Every external impulse work and applied force is recorded.
tuples: Nonmutating CYPS2 initial/final payloads independently checksum-validated and extracted, including masked and halo cells. Epoch excluded from material tuple multiset. Emissions/removal logged separately.
geometry: Record stored-material ROI and actual float32 Rapier basis; independent Python double clipping and cell-centre tests. Not original SOL authority or its acceptance oracle.
